env_vars.GITHUB_PAT: PRESENT (system env, visible via PowerShell GetEnvironmentVariable, NOT inherited by bash shell)
env_vars.GITHUB_TOKEN: PRESENT (inherited from previous session, likely old token)

github_pat_permission_probe.git_blobs_api_error: Resource not accessible by personal access token
github_pat_permission_probe.diagnosis: Fine-grained PAT has repo metadata push/admin via org role but lacks 'Contents: Write' PAT-scope. Git Data API (blob creation) enforces PAT-level permissions separately from org-level repo role. The 'allows_permissionless_access=true' header confirms only public/permissionless access is granted.

blocker_detail: GITHUB_PAT is a fine-grained PAT that was created without 'Contents: Read and write' permission for aspose-diagram-net/Aspose.Diagram.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples. The Git Data API returns HTTP 403 on blob creation despite repo metadata showing push=True (which reflects org role, not PAT scope).

fix_required.action: Edit the fine-grained PAT on GitHub Settings > Personal access tokens > Fine-grained tokens
fix_required.add_permission: Repository permissions > Contents: Read and write
fix_required.also_ensure: Pull requests: Read and write (required for PR creation step)
fix_required.then: Update GITHUB_PAT system env var with regenerated token value (fine-grained PATs must be regenerated after permission changes)
